title: Semantic Label Drift in Cross-Cultural Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating semantic label drift by translating culturally sensitive English datasets (mental health severity and irony) into culturally similar (Greek) and dissimilar (Bengali) languages, and comparing label preservation rates using both literal translation and anthropological prompting.

Measuring discrepancies in machine translation performance, label preservation, and translation refusal rates across different target languages (Greek vs. Bengali) using various traditional MT systems and Large Language Models.
